author: /root/ci_repair_review
assessment: Every new immutable source/path alias still issues a Git info lookup. Metadata accepts only a bounded hex OID, blob type and canonical nonnegative size; missing is a noncacheable unavailable response. Contents are requested by the resolved opaque OID and its complete header must exactly match metadata before framed bytes are accepted.

Positive OID reuse requires matching blob size and uses the same immutable bytes object. A previously unseen OID is refused before requesting contents when its body would exceed MAX_TOTAL. Only a fully framed newly fetched body charges total; aliases do not fetch or charge it again.

Only the serialized caller publishes positive bytes and body accounting. The single worker never repopulates either cache; after timeout/abort/close both caches clear, including cleanup-error finally paths. A late result cannot make the closed transaction readable.

Literal source/path validation, repository binding, no-replace/no-lazy-fetch Git invocation and local credential-blind environment are preserved. OIDs are Git identity correlation, not a new SHA1 implementation or independent cryptographic authentication.

MAX_BLOB16MiB, MAX_TOTAL256MiB, MAX_QUERIES16384 logical uncached aliases, query10s and transaction120s declarations remain unchanged. New bodies require info plus contents, while aliases require info only. Existing cached-exact-key timing behavior and cleanup verification budgets are not represented as a new hard overall wall-clock guarantee.

Unknown protocol types/headers, truncated payload, wrong newline, changed OID/type/size, final trailing stdout and nonzero final exit refuse the transaction. The existing primary exception, explicit cause/context and active-context restoration survive cleanup failure.

No proof, authorization, absence, readiness result or global/repository-crossing cache is added. Original owner integration still respects the injected loader and reuses only positive bytes within its current validation transaction.

All supplied raw hashes and four unchanged import-owner joins independently checked. Module AST outside Reader remains exactly unchanged.

reuse.scope: Previously inspected complete security policy and unchanged contributor/source trust boundaries reused; this is a fresh independent two-file code review, not self-review or a fleet.

limits: PASS applies only to the exact two sealed candidate files and patch. No staged candidate/index OID or marker is claimed or written.
No canonical/index/ref/ledger/marker/progress changes, tests, runtime/provider/API/network/build/install execution or new reviewer fleet. Fresh Temp receipt only.
Author disposable Git/Python receipts establish their named local fixture outcomes; inert protocol doubles do not qualify arbitrary real Git/OS containment.

The reader itself trusts the selected Git object service and correlates opaque Git OIDs; it does not recompute object digests, authenticate external provenance, cache authority decisions or prove absence.

Current full corpus, original full-owner performance, hosted/cross-platform compatibility and final staged-candidate review remain separate Root obligations. No full-owner success or performance improvement measurement is asserted.
